notes.title: Update 1.3.15 is Here: Mac Support and Ingredient Cloning! 🍔
notes.content:
Hello, Galactic Chefs!

We've just rolled out a new update for Galaxy Burger! Your incredible support helps us make the game better every day, and we're excited to share what's new.

This patch focuses on two major additions: official macOS support and a new ingredient cloning mechanic.

[h2]New Mechanic: Ingredient Cloning[/h2]

By popular demand, you can now [b]duplicate raw ingredients[/b] right in the middle of a shift. We hope this makes the gameplay feel smoother and a bit easier on your hands.

[b]How It Works:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Mouse:[/b] While holding an ingredient, right-click.
[*] [b]Gamepad:[/b] While holding an ingredient, press the [b]X[/b] button.
[/list]

We know many of you are also looking forward to grabbing multiple ingredients at once. This feature requires a major code overhaul, so we're not quite ready to release it yet, but it's definitely on our radar.

If the new cloning feature isn't your cup of tea, you can always disable it in the gameplay settings.

[h2]Official macOS Support[/h2]

You asked, and we listened! We're thrilled to announce that Galaxy Burger now has [b]full macOS support[/b]. The game runs great on a variety of Mac models and supports [b]cross-play with Windows[/b] and [b]cloud saves[/b] across platforms.

A huge thank you to everyone who helped us with testing! We're also here to provide official technical support.

[h2]Other Improvements[/h2]

We've also cooked up several other tasty changes and fixes:
[list]
[*] [b]Animations & Sounds:[/b] Polished the animations and sounds for handing over orders.
[*] [b]UI:[/b] Refreshed the loading screen and the end-of-shift results screen.
[*] [b]Multiplayer:[/b] Smoothed out item and stat synchronization for a better co-op experience.
[*] [b]Bug Fixes:[/b] Squashed a critical button conflict on gamepads and resolved several touch control issues.
[/list]

[h2]We Value Your Feedback[/h2]

We've added two new buttons to the settings menu:
[list]
[*] [b]"Report a Bug"[/b]
[*] [b]"Leave Feedback"[/b]
[/list]

All feedback is submitted [b]completely anonymously[/b]. Your input is invaluable in helping us improve the game, so please keep it coming!

[h2]Special Offer! -35% OFF[/h2]

To celebrate the update, we're kicking off a sale! Starting this evening (CET), Galaxy Burger will be available with a [b]35% discount[/b]. If you or your friends have been waiting to join our cosmic kitchen, this is the perfect chance!

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]

While our focus remains on Galaxy Burger, we'd also like to give you a sneak peek at our other projects.

First up is [b]Fantasy Burger[/b] - our next big cooking sim, set in a fantasy world with a red dragon and all-new cooking mechanics:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3514750/Fantasy_Burger/?utm_source=gp-upd-1-3-15

And then there's [b]Decor Quest[/b] - a cozy decoration game featuring a sassy cat who critiques your work:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3041940/Decor_Quest/?utm_source=gb-upd-1-3-15

We'd be grateful if you'd add these games to your Steam Wishlist. Stay tuned for more announcements!

[h2]Share Your Feedback[/h2]
By the way, you can now leave feedback not only from within the game. If you have ideas, suggestions, or have run into a bug, please fill out our [b][url=https://tinyurl.com/2kszbu7e]feedback form[/url][/b]. We read every single message!

Thanks for sticking with us! We hope you enjoy the new features.

[i]Best regards,
The Galaxy Burger Dev Team[/i]

notes.title: Update 1.3.12 + Mac OS support (in beta-testing)
notes.content:
Hey Chefs! We've focused on fairer order ratings, smoother co-op, and quality-of-life fixes. Here’s what’s new:

[list]
[*][b]Delivery Tray fixed:[/b] Only finished food goes to the tray. Tools, containers, and equipment no longer get sent by mistake.
[*][b]No accidental double-pick:[/b] If you already hold an ingredient, baskets won’t hand you another one.
[*][b]More reliable cooking surfaces:[/b] Ingredients sitting on other equipment are no longer treated as if they’re on the current one. The fryer ignores liquids and won’t grab items from the wrong parent.
[*][b]Fairer order ratings & smarter recipe recognition:[/b] The game better understands custom orders with wishes and won’t confuse them with similar recipes. 
For example: there was a case where a Sub‑Orbital Sandwich with excluded ingredients became identical to an Orbital Sandwich and got rejected — now the system recognizes this and the customer accepts the custom order.
[*][b]Perfect means 100%:[/b] Flawlessly prepared dishes now correctly show a full 100% score (no more 98–99% for perfection).
[*][b]“Vegan Menu” coupon availability tweaked:[/b] This coupon now appears only on planets/kitchens where a reasonable variety of vegan burgers can be cooked, avoiding situations with a menu reduced to just drinks or a single dish.
[*][b]Smoother co‑op gameplay:[/b] Reduced micro‑lags and stutters thanks to networking optimizations.
[*][b]Improved LAN connectivity:[/b] More reliable local play: better local IP selection with a safe fallback.
[*][b]Stability:[/b] Various background tweaks to improve overall reliability.
[/list]

[h2]macOS Beta (testing)[/h2]
[i]macOS support is available in beta and not yet officially listed on the store page while we finish full testing. You can try it now via the Steam beta branch (no password).[/i]

[b]How to enable the beta on macOS (or any platform):[/b]
[list]
[*]Open your Steam Library
[*]Right‑click [b]Galaxy Burger[/b] → [b]Properties[/b]
[*]Go to the [b]Betas[/b] tab
[*]Choose the branch: [b]beta[/b] (no password required)
[*]Close the window — Steam will download the beta. To return to stable, set Betas to “[b]None[/b]”.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960001/0e0ec60bbe374096e94053a65c29991f699b20de.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960001/c7676db987d7716700f38a962580748a1bf99a07.png[/img]

We’ve tested networking features (including LAN), and cross‑play between Windows and macOS worked smoothly in our tests. You can play together in the same co‑op session without issues.

[b]Please report any macOS issues[/b] (graphics, input, performance, stability) via the Steam Discussions — your feedback will help us finalize macOS support.

Thanks for playing, and see you in the kitchen!

notes.title: Galaxy Burger 1.3.11 Update is Live!
notes.content:
Lock Your Kitchen Gear & Enjoy a Smoother Experience!

[h2]Kitchen Customization Rules[/h2]
We heard you loud and clear! Many of you accidentally moved kitchen equipment with a misclick, and we know how frustrating that can be. To fix this, we've added a new "Kitchen Rules" section on the first page of the recipe book in "My Kitchen" mode.

You can now lock your kitchen equipment in place. In co-op, you can also stop friends from rearranging your carefully organized kitchen. These rules apply to all your kitchens.

[h2]Bug Squashing & Improvements[/h2]
This update also brings a bunch of important fixes to improve your gameplay:

[list]
[*]Fixed freezes when dropping boards loaded with ingredients.
[*]Resolved a bug with food containers when dragging a board with a food container ingredient near another one.
[*]Fixed a bug where clients could get stuck on a loading screen if the host quickly clicked "continue" in the coupons dialog.
[*]Fixed an issue with dragging and dropping food onto sauce bottles.
[*]Improved performance when you're using a lot of sauces.
[*]Smashed a critical bug where you could pick up two items at once (like a cup and a lid), blocking you from doing anything. This was especially easy to do when item stacks were close together.
[*]Ingredients on a board will no longer interact with cooktops or fryers while you move them around.
[*]We've made several other small fixes and optimizations to the network code for better stability and fewer crashes. We're still hunting down all crash-related bugs.
[*]Fixed the widget for our other games in the main menu for all languages. Buttons were sometimes displayed incorrectly, and the description text was often cut off.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support and feedback! We hope these changes make your culinary adventures in Galaxy Burger even more fun.

Happy cooking!
Galactic Workshop team.

notes.title: New Update 1.3: "My Kitchen" is Here!
notes.content:
Greetings, galactic chefs!

We're excited to announce that the [b]My Kitchen[/b] update for Galaxy Burger is now available!

[h2]The My Kitchen Feature[/h2]
You can now [b]drag and drop equipment and food containers[/b] anywhere in the kitchen! Create the perfect layout that works just for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960001/e24c46e384a341f5f3eeb3da849956fc2c4fdc64.gif[/img]
Your layout will be saved between shifts, so you can focus on what's most important—making delicious burgers for your customers.

[b]Please note:[/b] The My Kitchen feature unlocks once you reach a 3-star reputation on a planet.

[h2]New Dish Type: Sub Sandwiches[/h2]
Introducing a new dish type: [b]sub sandwiches[/b]! These tasty treats will be a great addition to your menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960001/2afadb64495ddfee19750de983fa07408c92cdde.png[/img]
What makes sub sandwiches special? Unlike burgers, the [b]ingredient order doesn't matter[/b]! No more memorizing complex recipes.

[h2]New Star System: Tabby[/h2]
Explore the new [b]Tabby star system[/b], featuring new planets to discover! Here you'll find [b]new ingredients[/b]: iceberg lettuce, quail eggs, ham, and a new type of pickle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960001/eca633d22a5e8c377c5e26602d9fa534c5c12744.png[/img]
[h2]New Customer Types[/h2]
Get ready for two new customer types: [b]Sweet Tooths[/b], who love sweets even in their burgers, and [b]Builders[/b], who order tons of ingredients to empty your stock—they don't even need the food itself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960001/ed4479a015a492cce3adf28d6c34d9513616bd33.png[/img]

[h2]Game Balance Improvements[/h2]
We've made progression smoother: we've [b]lowered the reputation requirements[/b] for getting 4 and 5 stars on planets and [b]reduced the cost and requirements[/b] for unlocking new star systems. Now, advancing in the game will be more comfortable for everyone.

We know waiting for patties and other ingredients to cook was tedious. So, we've [b]cut their cooking time by about 20%[/b] and increased the time before they burn. You won't have to watch the grill so closely anymore, giving you more time for other tasks!

[h2]Quality of Life Improvements[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960001/b41202678b1f023aa70bc867a54a1293d5d57e49.gif[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Zoom Level Saving[/b] - Your zoom level is now saved between shifts.
[*][b]Cursor Skin Customization[/b] - Choose from 9 different colors, perfect for co-op to tell players apart.
[*][b]Improved Drag and Drop[/b] - Now, when you let go of ingredients or equipment, they'll automatically snap to the nearest valid spot instead of returning to their original position.
[*][b]Random Planet Button[/b] - After your shift ends, you can instantly travel to another random unlocked planet in the current star system.
[*][b]UI Enhancements[/b] - We've updated the planet selection menu and the kitchen screen. For example, you can now see how many customers are waiting for their orders.
[*][b]Customer Feedback[/b] - If a customer isn't completely happy with their order, you can find out what they didn't like to avoid similar mistakes in the future.
[*][b]Information about our other games[/b] - You can now find information and links to our other projects in the main menu.
[*][b]VRAM (Video Memory) Optimization[/b] - Improved performance on computers with integrated graphics.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
We've fixed several bugs with coupons that weren't working correctly, like the one for tips. In co-op mode, we've added extra synchronization before a shift starts to make sure all players are loaded in.

We've also fixed many other issues you reported on the forums and in emails. We paid special attention to co-op mode: fixed several bugs, resolved desync issues, and improved overall stability. Thanks for your feedback!

[h2]🎉 Announcement: Fantasy Burger[/h2]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3514750?utm_source=gb-upd-1-3-news][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960001/5079d48956494d5cd49d227e8801382df366808e.png[/img][/url]
While you're cooking in space, we're already working on something new! We want to share the story behind our next game.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3514750?utm_source=gb-upd-1-3-news

For a long time, we wondered what to do next. Pizza? Coffee? It all felt too predictable. Then it hit us: what if we took our favorite cooking mechanics into a world of magic and fantasy?

[quote]Imagine: [b]Fantasy Burger[/b], a game where you'll cook not just food, but magical dishes for elves, dragons, and other mystical creatures! A huge kingdom map awaits explorers, and new dish types will unlock incredible possibilities. There's so much we can build around magic and fantasy![/quote]

[b]Important note:[/b] We will continue to support Galaxy Burger and release small updates with bug fixes for it.

[b]🎮 The game's page is already on Steam![/b] 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3514750?utm_source=gb-upd-1-3-news]Add Fantasy Burger to your wishlist[/url], to follow its development and get notified when the free demo is released. The release is planned for [b]Fall 2026[/b]. 🏰✨

[h2]Second Announcement: Decor Quest[/h2]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3041940/Decor_Quest/?utm_source=gb-upd-1-3-news][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960001/31e94085b0574386bc8b18eef6c48efa4136995e.png[/img][/url]

Additionally, we're working on [b]Decor Quest[/b]—a cozy sandbox game about decorating dream homes. And there's also a snobby cat who really dislikes being ignored! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3041940?utm_source=gb-upd-1-3-news
[quote]Our another artist, Maria Skokova, is working on this project. What's especially exciting is that Decor Quest will also feature a co-op mode for 2-4 players! The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3041940?utm_source=gb-upd-1-3-news]Decor Quest page[/url] is already available. The release is planned for [b]August 2026[/b]. 🏡[/quote]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3041940]Add Decor Quest to your wishlist[/url], so you don't miss the free demo coming in 2025.


[b]P.S.[/b]
See you in the space kitchen!
[i]The Galactic Workshop Team[/i]

notes.title: Holiday Update for Galaxy Burger! 🎄🎅❄
notes.content:
Dear burger lovers! We're excited to present the holiday update for [i]Galaxy Burger[/i]! The festive season has arrived, and your cosmic burger restaurant is now full of holiday spirit.

[h2]What's New[/h2]

[h3]✨ Festive Decorations[/h3]
- Holiday hats for staff and visitors.  
- A sparkling Christmas tree inside your restaurant!  
- Gentle snow falling outside to set the winter mood.  
[i]*If you're not a fan of the festive theme, don't worry — a new "Seasonal Decor Toggle" option in the settings lets you turn it off.*[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960001/a9cba64b8ba5933cc9b7d0232d0ee349b4eb5730.png[/img]

[h3]✨ Gameplay Improvements[/h3]
- More room for your creativity! We've expanded the save slots from three to seven.  
- Settings are now more convenient: you can disable tooltip popups when hovering over items.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960001/f2f54ccc28447444f68a1551cff4bb39a8471410.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960001/ccf3746873d6196f5314d44b88fd9139b0df8a7e.png[/img]

[h3]✨ Bug Fixes[/h3]
- Coupons for custom burgers no longer interfere with other coupons.  
- Vegan Menu now works properly — no more accidental meat orders!  
- Improved translations for French, Spanish, and Chinese with the help of our amazing players ([b]thank you, you're the best ❤️[/b]).  
- Significant improvements to the Japanese translation, making it more accurate and polished.  
- The game now launches almost instantly — no more loading screen!  

[h2]A Note From Us[/h2]

This year has been incredibly busy for our team! We recently participated in the cooking games festival, which was a fantastic experience. Your support and feedback gave us so much inspiration for future projects — thank you!  

On a personal note, I finally fulfilled a long-time dream and visited Southeast Asia, specifically Thailand. It's an amazing country with incredibly kind and welcoming people. While my travels occasionally delayed development, they also brought new perspectives and ideas that will surely influence our games.  

As the holiday season is here and we're taking a bit of a break until the end of the year, replies to emails and suggestions might be slower than usual. We hope for your understanding!

[h2]Thank You![/h2]

Thank you for your support, feedback, and bug reports! You make the game better with every update. We deeply appreciate your activity and engagement.  

We're taking a short break from development until the end of the year, but you can look forward to [b]exciting news[/b] at the start of next year!  

And don't forget to follow our developer page on Steam: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/GalacticWorkshop]Galactic Workshop[/url]. It's the best way to stay up-to-date with all our updates and upcoming projects!

See you in the new year, and happy holidays! 🎉  

[i]Yours truly,  
The Galaxy Burger Team 🌌🍔[/i]

notes.content:

- Fixed an issue where large numbers caused problems in co-op mode for some players.

notes.title: New update: Robotics! Robots and Coupons for kitchen upgrades!
notes.content:
Hey, friends! We’ve got some exciting news for all Galaxy Burger fans. Say hello to our big new update — [b]Robotics[/b]! Version 1.2 is here!

We’ve added delivery robots and introduced coupons that bring a whole new level of customization and fun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960001/969a50850ffc479b6e1491ee122a68f4c854fc2e.png[/img]

[h2]🤖 Delivery Robots — Space-Age Customers[/h2]  
Delivery robots are a fresh type of customer who are sure to shake things up. These androids occasionally visit planets with big orders, and while they cover the delivery costs themselves (unfortunately, no tips!), their visits impact the reputation not just of their current planet but also of the neighboring one they deliver to. So if a robot comes through your door, be ready to bring your A-game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960001/53b1b253ee62464ac015d6cdc317f42ed7c59d89.png[/img]

[h2]🎫 Coupons — Freedom to Customize[/h2]  
Once you reach two reputation stars on a planet, you’ll unlock coupons, available for in-game cash. Each coupon has its own rarity and effects: some speed up kitchen equipment, others boost tips, and there’s even a coupon that makes your entire menu vegan! Coupons give you the freedom to shape your gameplay your way. Want to speed things up? Done! Or maybe add a little extra flair to orders? It’s all up to you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960001/85ecdfbcc7856e74cf830e02021e48adfe085f82.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960001/c49ae94573128591be6f68eaf289bfa684b2043c.png[/img]

[h2]🔧 Fixes and Shoutouts[/h2]  
We’ve also put in work on various improvements and bug fixes. Special shoutout to [b]Regina Lurz[/b] for helping polish up the German translation! With players like her, our game keeps getting better and more accessible.

Plus, we’re always checking out your comments and feedback, whether on the forums or the Steam page. Every bit of feedback helps us make Galaxy Burger better, so keep those thoughts coming!

[h2]🍔 Cooking Games Festival & 20% Off[/h2]  
Starting November 11, Galaxy Burger will be part of the Cooking Games Festival! For anyone who’s been waiting to jump in, you can grab the game at 20% off during the festival.

Thanks for playing and supporting us! We love creating Galaxy Burger alongside you, and there’s so much more to come.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960001/49dcea7e1ba99b6d3860723e5baf925e84776932.png[/img]

[h2]🎄 P.S.[/h2]  
Around Christmas and New Year’s, we might just release a festive update to add some holiday cheer to your favorite space burger spot! And next year? Get ready for even more exciting news.

Lastly, it’s been incredible to see [b]Galaxy Burger[/b] win hearts all over the world: from the U.S. to China, South Korea, Japan, Canada, Germany, and so many other places. It’s a joy to know our game is bringing players together from all across the globe!

notes.title: We're cooking up a major update! What's in it? +20% OFF
notes.content:
Hey there, cooking game enthusiasts!

I’m here to share some exciting news about what's coming in our next update (tentatively version 1.2). We’re aiming to release it in mid-November 2024, just in time for the [b]Cooking Games Festival[/b].

This update is all about adding more variety and giving you new ways to spend your hard-earned cash besides just buying planets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960001/9572107028bd98a8528f8d8d17e9d3dd89058e99.png[/img]

[h2]🤖 Android Couriers[/h2] It's the 30th century, so of course we have robots! These android couriers don’t eat—nope, their job is to deliver food between planets. They'll be handling large orders across various planets, boosting your reputation not just where the order ends up but also on the planet it came from. And they’ll have a few other tricks up their sleeves too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960001/18b3dd6a24a73a89a7ddcbb9f0c01241086bfad7.gif[/img]

[h2]🃏🧙‍♀️ Upgrade Cards[/h2] We spent a lot of time thinking about the upgrade system that many of you asked for, and we've come up with something even more exciting! We're introducing an upgrade card system. At the start of each shift, you'll get random upgrade cards to choose from.

These cards will have all kinds of effects—like increasing order value, speeding up cooking times, changing a planet's menu, attracting special customers, bonus perks, and more. The effects of the cards will be temporary, lasting for one or more shifts, and their price will depend on rarity, duration, and the mix of positive and negative effects.

[h2]🪐🥬 Minor Tweaks and New Additions[/h2] We’ve got some new ingredients that will likely make it into this update. Plus, there's a good chance we'll be adding a new secret star system with its own planets to explore.

[h1]P.S.[/h1] We're thrilled that so many players are enjoying our game—it's been an incredible success for our small team! We've sold way more copies of Galaxy Burger than we ever imagined, and that allows us to keep improving the game and bring you new projects next year. ;)

We hope to have more exciting news and updates from our indie team soon!

[b]Follow us on Steam here[/b]: https://store.steampowered.com/developer/GalacticWorkshop (so you don’t miss anything awesome).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960001/229d434edef2f4c6409d04a3e78710e419d65861.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960001/fa4c4eab7155f3d83379cb712f153060846864db.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960001/1f2a9dceda92ab12753af479fae29e6ab128953a.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.1.1: Improvements, Fixes and Finnish language
notes.content:
Hi burger lovers!

We’re excited to bring you a small update. Honestly, the last two weeks haven’t been very productive for us since we needed some time off to unwind and relax after a long, intense development period. However, we’re still hard at work on a big update, and we’ll announce it very soon.

[h2]New[/h2]
- Added autosaving before and after each customer during a shift. Now you won’t have to worry about losing progress during endless shifts.
- Added Finnish localization, thanks to our fan Emmi.

[h2]Fixes and Improvements[/h2]
- Fixed customer visits on Photon Planet in Proxima, affecting only the first shift on this planet.
- Fixed the behavior of the help translation button in the main menu; it now opens a dedicated link on our forum.
- Fixed the strange cursor behavior when your gamepad has a drifting stick issue.
- Fixed ingredients freezing when dragged across the delivery food tray screens.
- Fixed the raw chicken patty issue where it had the "edible" flag, causing customers not to react when given raw chicken.
- Fixed flying ingredients that disappeared when flying across their baskets.
- Fixed a co-op bug where ingredients could be placed in the wrong spots if your partner was grabbing ingredients from the same position as you.

notes.title: Update 1.1: Now with Recipe Pinning!
notes.content:
Hey, everyone! The long-awaited weekend is just around the corner, and we've got an awesome update for you. We're always listening to your feedback, and this time we've added one of the most requested features.

[h2]Recipe Pinning[/h2]  
You can now pin up to 12 recipes to your desktop for quick access while cooking. No more flipping through the recipe book — cook with ease without relying on memory! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960001/4a041e4fa11c817ab40d70d13f4f2868e775e612.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960001/8818b10f77e226ecfa0706ee9f7b409b06a89aff.gif[/img]

Recipes can be pinned directly from checks or the recipe book.

[b]Not just burger recipes, but combos too![/b]  
You can now pin entire combo meals from the menu, not just individual recipes.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed an issue where online orders sometimes stopped being sent if the tray opened empty.
- Fixed: Hash browns were incorrectly marked as edible when raw.
- Fixed: If fries and other ingredients passed over the fryer in their containers, it showed as if they were submerged in oil.
- Fixed: Clicking on ticket numbers sometimes accidentally triggered items underneath, causing random ingredients to be grabbed from the table.
- Fixed the name of red bell pepper in the German localization.

[h2]P.S.[/h2]

notes.title: Update 1.0.7: Fixes, Improvements and Polish localizaton
notes.content:
[h2]New[/h2]
- Added Polish language. Huge thanks to our player Jakub "Linshi" Plichta for his hard work on the translation! If you want to switch to Polish, press the button with the Chinese character in the menu and select Polish there.

[h2]Fixes and Improvements[/h2]
- Fixed a bug where customers could request to remove an ingredient that wasn't in the recipe (most commonly with vegan customers).
- Improved allergic customers: for example, customers with an onion allergy will no longer order onion rings. The allergens are now displayed on receipts.
- Fixed a bug with phantom customers at the order counter, which occurred mostly when clicking on delivery screens.
- Fixed an issue where tongs would get stuck when handling eggs.
- Optimized performance when a large amount of sauce is applied to ingredients.
- Fixed an issue where large amounts of spilled sauce would start disappearing.
- Fixed a bug where sauce bottles could be placed on the automatic order belt.
- Fixed an issue where player data was not syncing correctly after recreating a session on the same planet in co-op mode.
- Fixed interface bugs where windows would overlap incorrectly.
- Corrected the display of the maximum reputation stars in the save menu — previously, it showed the maximum stars of the current star system.
- Improved switching between mouse and gamepad controls — now, moving the mouse or gamepad stick will automatically switch the input. Previously, some players thought mouse and keyboard controls were not working.
- Fixed an issue where the coffee machine stream would shrink and disappear after pressing the buttons repeatedly.
- Fixed bugs related to the Esc key and the back button on gamepads, where it wouldn’t always close the expected window.
- Fixed an issue where the frying sound would play if an object was placed near the fryer.
- Fixed a bug where warp jump achievements to different systems weren’t tracking correctly for non-host players in co-op mode.

[b]P.S.[/b] We read all your comments and feedback. We may not be able to reply to everyone right away, but we’re listening! Several fans have reached out about helping with translations, and we haven’t responded to all emails yet. Don’t worry — we’ll get back to you! I go through the emails every morning. =)

notes.title: ARE YOU READY? The release is coming soon! What's exciting in the game?
notes.content:
Hey there, burger lovers! I thought it was time to break the silence a bit =)

With just 3 days left until release, I wanted to share some exciting news about the game and behind-the-scenes details of developing Galaxy Burger. First off, I’ll be answering a lot of your questions.

The game will be released on August 23rd at 09:00 AM (EDT, New York), 15:00 (CEST, Berlin), and 21:00 (CST, Beijing).

[h1][b]FAQ[/b][/h1]
[h3][b]Is it fun to play both solo and in co-op?[/b][/h3]
We've designed the game to be engaging for both modes. You can play solo and then invite friends to join your game, or go through the entire game alone or with others. You can switch between solo and co-op at any point in your playthrough.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960001/2b99fc68e3e479ad9039b2aa594839bed3ccedcd.png[/img]

[h3][b]No rush or stress in a cooking game? How?[/b][/h3]
In many cooking games, you're pressured by timers or customer patience levels. But in Galaxy Burger, there's no rush. The key is to prepare the order correctly and cook it to perfection.

[h3][b]But I like the rush, chaos, and timers! Is there any of that?[/b][/h3]
For those who love time-based challenges, we’ve added game modes where customer patience comes into play. This mode is available on all levels and offers triple the rewards per shift.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960001/0e1255e2bcac6a3ddba8c52af18d32adce209cfb.png[/img]

[h3][b]What’s different from the demo?[/b][/h3]
In short: new recipes, more varied characters, diverse orders, combo meals, new planets and star systems, coffee and new drinks, additional game modes, more customization options, and countless little improvements. We’ve also upgraded the game’s art style.

[h3][b]The demo had bugs. Have you fixed them?[/b][/h3]
We’ve fixed tons of bugs over the past two months. The demo version doesn’t include these fixes, but rest assured, 99% of the demo’s bugs have been resolved in the full game.

[h3][b]Is it fun to play with kids?[/b][/h3]
We’ve tried to make the game family-friendly. We had several playtests where people played with their young children, and they all loved it. It surprised us—we didn’t expect the game to appeal so much to kids, not just adults.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960001/41b1dcba1bd73d8f6e210b604ed02450ef6aeb7f.png[/img]

[h3][b]How much will the game cost?[/b][/h3]
We’ve aimed for an affordable price. The game will be priced at $9.6 in the US, with a 20% launch discount. Similar pricing will apply in Europe. There will also be lower regional prices for countries in Asia and other regions.

[h3][b]How well does the game support gamepads?[/b][/h3]
We’ve built great support for Xbox controllers and similar devices. Playing with a gamepad is comfortable and intuitive. The game will likely work on PS controllers too.

[h3][b]Steam Deck?[/b][/h3]
The game runs perfectly on Steam Deck, and with the controller support, you won’t face any control issues.

[h3][b]How many hours of content are there?[/b][/h3]
To unlock all levels and enjoy the full content, it should take around 15-20 hours. Completing the game with 100% achievements will likely take even longer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960001/826a9382019dd00072494b45ce9d7460e854aaca.png[/img]

[h3][b]Will you be adding more content after release?[/b][/h3]
We’re planning to release several major updates and free DLC. The first major update is expected in October 2024, but what’s in it is still a secret.

[h3][b]Who developed the game?[/b][/h3]
It’s just two of us: me, Dima Zaitsev, the programmer and game designer, and Oleg Savin, the artist and musician. We also got a lot of help with testing from my wonderful partner, Maria Skokova. Plus, many of our friends supported us with testing. We’re professionals in our field, and game development has been a dream come true for me. We pour all of our time into making games.

[h1]P.S.[/h1]
If I missed anything, feel free to ask questions in the comments.

Also, please follow us on Steam by clicking the "Follow" button. Your support means the world to us!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2749770/Galaxy_Burger/

notes.title: What's coming in the full game? The release is already on Aug 23, DON'T MISS IT!
notes.content:
Hello burger lovers!

We're actively finishing up the development of Galaxy Burger and preparing the game for release. We've got a lot of exciting things to show you!

First off, everything's going great, and the game release won't be delayed. The game will be available on August 23rd.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960001/d952d4dfc32a1c160a54278f7d16d2a5f2cd3fc7.gif[/img]

[h2]Toasts and Sandwiches[/h2]
The game will put a big emphasis on toasts and sandwiches. In one star system, they're particularly fond of egg and bacon toasts and sandwiches. But don't worry, there'll be sweet toasts with fruits too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960001/9c62c28172f0b20da470ed342b83330c7193eb31.png[/img]

[h2]Diverse Orders[/h2]
Customers will sometimes ask to add something extra to their burger or even exclude something. Plus, there'll be unusual visitors making strange orders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960001/d347a73a934438ccdc958d883e67c42eb1985f2b.png[/img]

[h2]Combo Orders[/h2]
We've added the concept of Combos to the game. For example, the Galaxy Combo includes a Galaxy Burger + Fries + Drink. Sometimes customers will order specific combos by name. A combo is like a recipe, but consists of several recipes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960001/7373638df7ffb9cfe34ddf49e9bfd37122da26e5.png[/img]

[h2]Rice Burgers[/h2]
While it might seem simple, a bun made of rice grilled on a pan isn't that straightforward. The game will feature a special category of rice burgers and special recipes where customers order rice with meat or vegetables.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960001/6783a41c274b94512358dbdc056a4bc09eba207b.png[/img]

[h2]Coffee Machine[/h2]
As promised, we've added coffee machines. Now the game has hot drinks like Americano, Cappuccino, and even hot milk (cats will be pleased).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960001/219ede5935bb5dd2c76beec36fc7c04baaf40b9f.png[/img]

[h2]Unique Characters[/h2]
The customers will now be unique, with their own quirks and characteristics. Different types of characters will appear on various planets. Some are bread lovers, others like everything extra crispy, and some are always in a hurry. Each personality trait affects the customer's order, reaction, and rating.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960001/28742a7452a81754c54a4d512a685d0464aa4649.png[/img]

[h2]Online Delivery[/h2]
We've added a special new type of cash register for online orders, where customers place orders via online calls. Interacting with online cash registers is slightly different from regular ones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960001/1df9b46d39017ee6763d3daf221403d6323826da.png[/img]

[h2]Reputation and Ratings[/h2]
Inspired by Michelin stars, we've added reputation and the ability to earn reputation stars on each planet. When you move up to a new star on a planet, you'll unlock more options: more ingredients, more kitchen appliances, bigger tips, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960001/17ab52e31d1c18719505e7bc0ab4582ce90af834.png[/img]

[h2]New Star Systems[/h2]
We've added 3 more star systems with new levels to the game. As you earn money and increase your reputation, you'll be able to unlock them all. The combinations of levels are incredibly diverse and won't let you get bored with the cooking routine!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960001/e460c0d7d6bd404f9049b901d306c2a2934e1066.png[/img]

[h2]Improvements and Refinements[/h2]
We've fixed most of the bugs you reported to us. However, we haven't made any fixes to the demo version of the game, so keep that in mind.

1. We've made the recipe book more user-friendly, with easier and more intuitive navigation.
2. We've added hotkeys and improved gamepad support.
3. The sounds, animation, and graphics have become much better and more pleasant, creating a more relaxing atmosphere.
4. We've added even more types of ingredients and recipes. Some planets now even have their signature burger recipes.
5. Numerous minor tweaks and improvements that are hard to list right now.

[h2]Improvements for Co-op Mode[/h2]
We're preparing a special game mode with huge tables and a large flow of visitors.

[h1]P.S.[/h1]
Here's a secret: there'll be a 20% discount at launch! You'll be able to buy the game for $5-10 depending on your region, including the discount.

[h3]Add the game to your wishlist, or else...[/h3]
Otherwise, you simply won't get a notification from Steam when the game is released. If you add the game to your wishlist, it'll make it more popular. This is very important for our small team, and we'd be very grateful!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2749770/Galaxy_Burger/

.... Also, our first game is on sale until July 22nd. It's our first project that we worked on for 2.5 years, and it also has mecha cats, even more aliens, and tons of fun.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1571990/Galaxy_Pass_Station/
